intro: A magnetic gift presentation case with its own carry handle for handing over a boxed assortment. Seasonal artwork is an example, not a separate product or a guaranteed delivery programme.
measure: Complete gift length, width and height, proposed insert layout, total filled mass and required handle clearance

question: How is this different from a gift bag or a standard magnetic gift box?
answer: This brief combines an enclosed presentation case, magnetic closure and an attached carry handle. A gift bag uses a different body and handle arrangement, while the existing standard magnetic box is not presented as an integrated handled case. Review internal fit, handle attachment and filled-pack handling on this specific construction rather than transferring another format's specification.
additionalFaq: Is there a published safe carrying weight?

No carrying-weight rating is published here. Provide the complete filled mass and intended handoff so the proposed board, handle and reinforcement can be reviewed. Check a fully packed sample before approving the construction; the image is not a load test.
Can the Christmas print be replaced with our branding?

Custom artwork can be reviewed for the same handled-case brief. Provide your logo, colors, finish locations and quantity per design. The approved dieline, sample, applicable MOQ and schedule are confirmed for that specification; a new print is not another structural product.

structure: House-shaped presentation body with pitched gable ends and an opening roof cover above the gift compartment

measure: Packed gift footprint, maximum product height, usable space below the roof, insert layout and clearance for opening the cover
checks: Measure usable internal space below the sloping roof, not just the external peak height.

quoteBrief: Send a dimensioned gift layout, tallest item, filled mass, quantity per artwork and delivery country. Describe the required roof opening and any insert, individual packs or ribbon. Ask for the usable internal dimensions and a structural sample of the complete proposed construction. Confirm print files, component scope, applicable MOQ and schedule in the quotation.
question: Is this the same as a gable-top takeaway meal box?
answer: No. This reference is a house-shaped presentation pack whose roof cover opens over a gift compartment. The existing gable meal carton uses another folding and carrying arrangement for takeaway orders. Do not transfer its handle, assembly, dimensions or food-use specification to this gift box.
additionalFaq: How should the gift height be measured under a pitched roof?

Provide each item's maximum packed height and its position in the proposed layout. Request usable internal height at those positions, including insert and cover clearance. External peak height alone does not describe the space available to the products.
Does the house-shaped box include an advent calendar or food compartments?

Not by default. This page describes the opening-roof presentation body shown in the reference. Numbered compartments, individual cartons, dividers, food wraps and contents are separate requirements that must be identified and confirmed in the quotation.

selectionGuide.title: Build the opening-roof gift brief.

rows: Lay out the complete gifts and primary wraps. Provide the occupied base area and the position of each item.
Request usable height beneath the sloping roof and clearance through its opening path, including any insert.
Identify the outer body, roof cover, insert, individual packs and decorative pieces required in the quotation.
Provide roof and wall artwork separately against the approved dieline. Confirm orientation across the gable ends and opening panels.

distinct: Pitched-roof house presentation body with an opening roof cover, distinct from a carry-handle gable meal carton, plain lift-off gift box and numbered advent cabinet. Other artwork references of this house construction are consolidated.
